title: DLSA Moradabad Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for Various Para Legal Officer Posts
description: The District Legal Services Authority (DLSA Moradabad) has announced the official notification for the recruitment of 01 Para Legal Volunteer post. Candidates who have qualified in 10th Pass can grab this chance and apply for the DLSA Moradabad Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply offline before the last date of application...
